rationale: Owner-observed pattern: verification subagents hang forever on compound shell commands (e.g. wl-copy/wl-paste/hyprctl | python3 json.load with no timeout). Wayland clipboard is offer-based (supplier must stay alive); hyprctl IPC can hang; a stdin-consumer (python json.load) then waits forever and the whole tool call never returns. Rule from now on: wrap EVERY external/GUI/IPC command in timeout(1); never pipe an unguarded producer into a stdin consumer; prefer timeout on the producer side so EOF propagates; use wl-copy --foreground under timeout or stage-then-read quickly; keep sleeps minimal; verify restoration with timeout-guarded queries.

Hyprland-like semantics: gaps_in between split siblings at every Split level, gaps_out insets container once.

consequences: Opacity<1 now visibly bleeds wallpaper on Wayland (premultiplied surface). Platforms without PreMultiplied stay opaque + warn. No live-reload caller exists today; configure-time wiring only (Surface::set_opacity available for future reload work).
context: window.opacity 0.5/0.0 rendered identical to 1.0 on Wayland: platform only toggles winit set_transparent(true) (wl_surface opaque region None); no renderer alpha existed (CTX-0261 rerun VERDICT). Options: (a) renderer alpha scaling, (b) documented-unsupported + fail-closed validation.
decision_body: Choose (a): single-pass premultiplied alpha. Surface alpha_mode=PreMultiplied when opacity<1 (chosen only from caps.alpha_modes; Opaque/Auto when 1.0). Fill/glyph fragment shaders emit premultiplied color scaled by opacity uniform; alpha blend pins destination alpha ((Zero,One)) so the buffer keeps uniform alpha=opacity; clear color premultiplied (bg*o,o). Headless compositor scales the finished premultiplied buffer by o for CI-parity tests. o=1.0 leaves the blend equation bit-identical to today.
rationale: Feasible within scope: pipeline already owns fill+glyph WGSL; a uniform + 2 blend-component changes avoid an offscreen texture/second pass and extra VRAM. wgpu 26 requires alpha_mode be selected from SurfaceCapabilities (unsupported non-Auto errors), so configure picks from caps and falls back to opaque with a loud warning (honest + documented). Keeps diff disjoint from CTX-0291 (image blits untouched).
